_variant_note: GENERAL EVAL — WRITE-AFTER-CORRECTION trap. Customer says 'send duplicate statement from 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30.' Model calls get_transaction_history for the date range, but the account was opened 2026-03-01 — no transactions exist before March 2026. The earliest available date is 2026-03-01. Model must correct the customer in prose AND propagate the corrected from_date (2026-03-01) into request_duplicate_statement. arg_gate pins from_date=2026-03-01.

setup.persona: 20-year-old male, Supervisors and Foremen and Related Trades Workers in Painting, Building Structure, rural Baran, Rajasthan

user_turns.content: Email me a duplicate account statement for the period January to June 2026 — I need it for my tax filing.
Ok, send it for March to June then.

get_transaction_history._comment: Account opened 2026-03-01. No records before March 2026. The earliest transaction is from 2026-03-05. Customer asked Jan-Jun 2026 but Jan+Feb are outside the coverage window. Correction: from_date should be 2026-03-01.

output.message: Duplicate statement request logged for TKCSC9400001 (2026-03-01 to 2026-06-30). Will be emailed to your registered email.

get_account_details._comment: Account opened 2026-03-01 — this provides the earliest date context.

get_transaction_history._comment: Must fetch transaction history — reveals the earliest transaction is from March 2026, not January.

request_duplicate_statement._comment: CORRECTED from_date=2026-03-01. Customer said January 2026 but the account was opened March 2026 — no data before then. from_date pinned to the earliest available date. to_date=2026-06-30 stays as requested.

get_account_details._comment: Noise — optional (open_date context helpful but not required).

gold.expected_resolution: Write-after-correction trap. Customer says 'statement from January to June 2026.' get_transaction_history shows the earliest transaction is from March 2026 (the account was opened March 1). January and February 2026 have no data. The assistant must correct: 'Your account was opened in March 2026, so there are no records before then. I'll send the statement for March to June 2026 instead.' After confirmation, calls request_duplicate_statement with from_date=2026-03-01. A weak model may acknowledge the date issue in prose but still pass the original from_date. arg_gate pins from_date=2026-03-01; passing 2026-01-01 fails A3 via required exact-match.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant fetches transaction history, identifies the account was opened March 2026 so January to February has no data, communicates the date-range correction to the customer, and after confirmation calls request_duplicate_statement with from_date=2026-03-01 and to_date=2026-06-30. FAIL if from_date is passed as 2026-01-01.
